en.headline: Exchange Fund assets fall to HK$4.34 trillion at end-August
en.dek: The Monetary Authority said the drop of HK$68.3 billion from July was mainly due to withdrawals of Fiscal Reserves placements.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Wednesday that Exchange Fund assets stood at HK$4,335.4 billion at the end of August, HK$68.3 billion lower than at the end of July.

Foreign-currency assets fell by HK$68.0 billion and Hong Kong-dollar assets by HK$0.3 billion. The Authority said the decline in foreign-currency assets was mainly due to withdrawals of Fiscal Reserves placements, while Hong Kong-dollar assets slipped on mark-to-market revaluation of local equities.

The Currency Board Account showed the monetary base at HK$2,080.2 billion at end-August, up HK$0.1 billion, or 0.01 per cent, from July. Backing assets rose HK$3.2 billion, or 0.14 per cent, to HK$2,329.9 billion. The backing ratio increased from 111.86 per cent to 112.00 per cent.

The Authority separately released August residential mortgage figures: new loan applications fell 8.3 per cent from July to 8,446, new approvals dropped 28.2 per cent to HK$32.2 billion, and outstanding mortgages rose 0.6 per cent to HK$1,975.4 billion. The delinquency ratio stayed at 0.11 per cent.

zh.headline: 外匯基金8月底總資產降至4.34萬億
zh.dek: 金管局公布較7月底減少683億元，主因提取財政儲備存款；支持比率升至112%。
body: 香港金融管理局星期三公布，截至8月31日，外匯基金總資產為43,354億港元，較7月底減少683億元。
外幣資產減少680億元，港元資產減少3億元。金管局表示，外幣資產下跌主要因為提取財政儲備存款，港元資產則主要受本地股票按市價重估影響。
貨幣發行局帳目顯示，8月底貨幣基礎為20,802億元，較7月底增加1億元，升幅0.01%。支持資產增加32億元至23,299億元，支持比率由111.86%升至112.00%。
金管局同日公布8月住宅按揭統計：新申請按月減少8.3%至8,446宗，新批出貸款減少28.2%至322億元，未償還按揭增加0.6%至19,754億元，拖欠比率維持0.11%。
